subject.title: Cron Jobs Calendar View for Control UI

question: Should OpenClaw accept a built-in Control UI cron calendar/timeline view now, and should https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/41892 be repaired or replaced as the implementation path?
rationale: The issue requests a new user-facing Control UI mode rather than broken documented behavior, and the linked implementation PR is open, stale against current UI paths, and already has product/compatibility review concerns.

options.title: Repair narrow timeline first
options.body: Use the linked PR or a replacement branch for a scheduler-accurate read-only 24-hour timeline before broader calendar editing features.

options.title: Design the full calendar scope
options.body: Pause implementation until daily, weekly, heatmap, popup, validator, and drag-and-drop behavior are specified together.

options.title: Decline core calendar view
options.body: Keep the current list and run-history UI as the core cron surface and close the linked feature work if maintainers do not want this in core.

recommendation.title: Repair narrow timeline first
recommendation.body: Use the linked PR or a replacement branch for a scheduler-accurate read-only 24-hour timeline before broader calendar editing features.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest recent routing signal across the current and legacy Control UI cron files and product-surface history.
